response.overview: Ola de Calor (Spanish for "Heat Wave") is an upcoming professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event will take place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States. The event will take place right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue. The event will go head-to-head against rival company All Elite Wrestling's pay-per-view event All In.
response.tagline: THE HEAT OF LUCHA LIBRE IS COMING TO TEXAS.
response.title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
